scope: Seven pages; CAMP and single-cell only
excluded_presentation: FUSCC and Tang ASNS external association results
p_values: Frozen CAMP, COAD sign test and PRAD paired test only; ASNS and PDAC single-cell descriptive
expression: log1p(gene raw count / full gene-expression library * 10000)
umap: Original accepted coordinates and author annotations reused; no new embedding or batch correction
umap_scale: 0 to each panel positive-expression 99th percentile; zeros light gray
private_data: All per-cell, per-patient and per-ROI tables remain server165
PDAC_contrast: Same untreated patient CAF vs malignant epithelial, >=20 nuclei per group
replaces_PDac_prior_contrast: v1 7/9 malignant-vs-ductal is a different comparison and is not reused as CAF evidence
